evidence: Carries the Wallet label and deletes wallet database transaction removal routines across src/wallet/.
rationale: Removing the deprecated `removeprunedfunds` RPC and its underlying transaction deletion code eliminates complex in-memory and database synchronization logic. As noted by the author, 'there is never a good reason to delete tx data from a wallet', making this a beneficial cleanup of legacy deletion paths, but reasonably deferrable since it does not fix an active defect.
